The true Sovereign is witness and testimony that not a moment passeth save that we cherish the hope that once again we may gather as birds in the shadow of the Beloved and give utterance to His praise. Unto each and every one I convey, in the language of humility, greeting and salutation.

His honor Diya, upon him be My glory: God willing, may he attain unto that which is loved and well-pleasing.

## BH10856: Say: Glory be to Thee, O my God! I… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty, the Great!

Say: Glory be to Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy most sweet call, and by the Name of Thy Most Great, Most Glorious Name, and by Thy [perspicuous] Book and Thy firm [and steadfast] Cause, to ordain for Thy loved ones the good of this world and of the world to come. Then open before their faces the doors of Thy grace and blessing. Verily, Thou art the All-Powerful over whatsoever Thou willest, and within Thy grasp are the reins of all who are in the heavens and on earth.

## BH10868: The inscribed Tablet hath descended from the heaven… {.unnumbered}

He is God, the Mighty

The inscribed Tablet hath descended from the heaven of loving-kindness and hath made manifest the hidden meanings like unto a spiritual sun from the mystic horizon. Without proof it showed the way, and without Gabriel it guided the sorrowful heart to the path of joy. God willing, so long as the divine lamp shineth in the eternal niche, that true Beauty shall remain established upon the throne of everlasting glory.

## BH10870: My soul be a sacrifice unto Thee {.unnumbered}

My soul be a sacrifice unto Thee.

The glad tidings of Thy well-being and Thy blessed bounty were, in truth, the very ground of being and the secret source of true joy. They quickened the soul and renewed the spirit. Were we to lay before Thee the darkness of separation and the traces thereof, there is fear lest some dust of sorrow should settle upon the pure hem of Thy sanctified robe. We are athirst for reunion and long for the Kawthar of Thy presence. Without Thee, we are as a fish cast upon the dust.

## BH10873: Your letter was received. Praise be to God, we… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Glorious.

Your letter was received. Praise be to God, we are well. Just now I have come forth from the bath. On Friday or Saturday, with the help of God, We shall turn Our steps toward those regions. From every side, abide settled and at ease beneath the shadow of God. Distribute the things that have been sent, and give some also to Liqa'iyyih and Qudsi. The necessary items for Ma'sumih are being procured here.

## BH10874: Mahd-i-‘Ulya—your messenger—arrived. The letter was seen, but the instructions… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Wise.

Mahd-i-‘Ulya—your messenger—arrived. The letter was seen, but the instructions for proceeding did not come. Write what must be done and send word. The honored ones intend to depart in the morning, but the remaining matters must first be made clear—that is, the marriage contract and other such affairs—so that the agents may understand and act accordingly. I remember them all and send my greetings. Peace and glory be upon you and upon all who are with you, men and women alike.

## BH10875: The letter of that spiritual loved one was received… {.unnumbered}

He is the Beloved.

The letter of that spiritual loved one was received. From its fragrance the Tree of affection was stirred into joyous motion. The pen is but an interpreter, yet every arrival is fair [?], and every means but an instrument for the expression of meaning. The blessed verse saith: "God bringeth no affairs to pass save through their means." This is the greater glory: that thou shouldst behold the Friend, and not thyself. Peace be upon thee and upon those that are with thee. His Holiness the Afnan is remembered under all conditions and is graced with a special favor.

## BH10876: His exalted Word {.unnumbered}

His exalted Word:

The letter from the shaykh of the greater city, upon him be My glory, was considered. The glance of favor is directed toward each one. Convey My greetings on behalf of the Wronged One and say: You have ever been and continue to be before Our sight. The Self of Truth hath testified to your acceptance, your turning and your steadfastness. Upon you be My remembrance, My praise, My glory and My mercy which hath preceded all who are in the heavens and the earth. And praise be to God, the Lord of the worlds.

## BH10878: Gaze with the light of the lamp, whose effulgence… {.unnumbered}

He is the Ever-Abiding.

Gaze with the light of the lamp, whose effulgence hath shone, and shall continue to shine, upon its appointed seat. Wherefore, be ye established, O people of the earth, in this divine lamp and this peerless light. My Pen, which is nearer unto Me than all thingsâ€"should it be removed unto another place, it would remain deprived of this nearness. Thus do thou comprehend all that ye desire to know.

## BH10879: Send down] blessings upon His Light, through which He… {.unnumbered}

[Send down] blessings upon His Light, through which He illumined the world, and made Him the Seal of His Messengers and His Prophets, and chose Him from among His servants for the manifestation of His Cause and the exaltation of His Word; and through Him He guided the affirmers of His unity unto His straight Path and His Most Great Announcement.

And [blessings] upon His kindred and His companions, whom God made the standards of His victory in His lands and the banners of His power among His people: blessings which neither the Praised One shall gainsay, nor the Tongue of utterance find fault with. Verily, He is the Mighty, the All-Bountiful.

## BH10881: This is Our remembrance for him who consorted… {.unnumbered}

This is Our remembrance for him who consorted with his Lord yet knew Him not, who heard the call of God yet answered it not, and upon whom in every moment there shone forth the Sun of Beauty from the horizon of glory, yet he recounted not its effulgences. Would that he had paused in his affair and been content with what We have mentioned, and that there had not issued from his mouth that which caused the hearts of the pure ones to be consumed....

## BH10883: This is a Book from Us to him who… {.unnumbered}

This is a Book from Us to him who answered his Lord when the Call was raised from the right of the Mount through this Revelation, wherewith the All-Merciful hath come with manifest sovereignty. O My God and My Lord! Adorn the temples of Thy servants with the ornament of Thy most beauteous Names, even as Thou hast adorned the Throne with the lights of Thy Most Glorious Name. Then give them to drink of the sealed wine in this Day that is hidden and concealed, for verily Thou art the Sovereign of the unseen and the seen.

## BH10887: Whoso, in this day, hath attained unto and been… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Glorious.

Whoso, in this day, hath attained unto and been blessed with the lights of the Sun of Truth, he is, by the Most Exalted Pen, reckoned and inscribed in the Book among the people of Bahá. We beseech God that He debar not the world from the Kawthar of everlasting life which floweth from the Pen of the Ancient King. To Him be praise! His grace laid hold upon thee, guided thee aright, and thou didst attain, didst behold, and didst hear. His is the bounty and the bestowal.

## BH10891: O My Leaf! Hearken thou unto My Voice: Verily… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Glorious

O My Leaf! Hearken thou unto My Voice: Verily there is none other God but Me, the Almighty, the All-Wise. I can well inhale from thee the fragrance of My love and the sweet-smelling savour wafting from the raiment of My Name, the Most Holy, the Most Luminous. Be astir upon God's Tree in conformity with thy pleasure and unloose thy tongue in praise of thy Lord amidst all mankind. Let not the things of the world grieve thee. Cling fast unto this divine Lote-Tree from which God hath graciously caused thee to spring forth. I swear by My life! It behoveth the lover to be closely joined to the loved one, and here indeed is the Best-Beloved of the world.

## BH10900: O Afnan! The children of this age have stepped… {.unnumbered}

O Afnan! The children of this age have stepped into the arena of speech and utterance, and from their words the utmost deficiency is made plain. They have girded up their loins and drawn themselves to full stature, yet they have clung unto outworn names. But the hidden powers, the penetrating and mighty Will, the endeavor of the well-known chosen ones, and hands that are outstretched, have exalted a Cause that stood opposed to the judgment of all the tribes of the world.

## BH10904: O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou hast subdued the kingdom of names, and whereby the Ark of Thy Cause hath sailed upon the sea of Thy Most Glorious Name. O Lord! This is Thy Day, wherein Thou hast opened the gates of Thy bounty unto all who are in Thy heaven and on Thy earth.

I entreat Thee that Thou make me not deprived of the breaths of Thy revelation in Thy days. He whom Thou hast honoured with Thy days and exalted through Thy signs—cast him not away from Thy loving care. Verily, Thou art the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent.

## BH10906: O my God! This is Thy servant who hastened… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Glorious!

O my God! This is Thy servant who hastened to the fields of Thy mercy and ran to the wilderness wherein no voice is heard except Thy voice, and who sought to drink from the clouds of Thy grace and bounty. Therefore, O my God, disappoint him not in what he seeketh from Thy generosity and favor. Clothe him with the garments of immortality in Thy most exalted Paradise and Thy most glorious Companion. Then grant him that which will cause him to ascend unto the stations of nearness, "the distance of two bow-lengths or even less."

## BH10908: O my God and my Lord! I beseech Thee… {.unnumbered}

He is the Almighty.

O my God and my Lord! I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy Kingdom and the mysteries of Thy Dominion, and by Thy Name through which Thou hast subdued Thy earth and Thy heaven and illumined the hearts of Thy servants, to ordain for me the reward of every martyr and every trustworthy one and every steadfast one and every upright one. O my Lord! Withhold not Thy servants from turning to the ocean of Thy bounty and Thy grace. Verily, Thou art the Forgiving, the Generous.

## BH10911: O thou who didst speak forth the ordinances… {.unnumbered}

O thou who didst speak forth the ordinances of God in former days, and who dost now make mention of His Cause! Say once again:

Praised be Thou, O my God, for that Thou hast remembered me when I was a wronged and imprisoned one in the hands of the heedless. I beseech Thee by Thy Name that hath subdued all names, and by the light of Thy Cause and the fire of Thy Lote-Tree, to make me of those whom neither name nor outward station, neither awe nor power, hath hindered from turning toward the court of Thy nearness. O Lord! I am the poor one, and Thou art the All-Wealthy, the Overpowering, the Omnipotent.

## BH10920: O people of God! By the life of God!… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing

O people of God! By the life of God! Verily the Wronged One is in manifest sorrow. We took clods of dust and raised them up, establishing them above the heavens; yet the recompense for this bounty was treachery. He committed that which caused the Eye of God to weep and the Most Exalted Pen to lament. Nevertheless, the Wronged One hath clung to the cord of patience, and He is the Concealer, the Patient, the Mighty, the All-Powerful.

Should anyone desire to know that mentioned oppressor: he is named Yahya in the Book of Names. We bear witness that he is of the wrongdoers in My perspicuous Book.

## BH10928: O Dhu'l-Fiqar! Upon thee be the glory of God… {.unnumbered}

He is the Rememberer of His loved ones.

O Dhu'l-Fiqar! Upon thee be the glory of God, thy Lord, the Unconstrained.

Say: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy most glorious glory, and by all Thy splendor, which is resplendent, to send down upon Thine elect and Thy loved ones, from the heaven of Thy bounty, the table of the knowledge of Thee. Verily, Thou art the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent.

Glory be upon thee, and upon thy brother who hath ascended unto God, and upon thy family and those who are with thee in this Most Great Cause and this mighty Announcement.

## BH10941: This is the Tablet of God, the Help… {.unnumbered}

He is the Glorious, the All-Glorious!

This is the Tablet of God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting.

O My servant, O Thabit! There hath been sent down in a Book concerning him who loveth Me—We have made mention of thee time and again that thou mayest render thanks unto thy Lord, the Manifestor of clear evidences. We have heard thy call and have summoned thee from the direction of the Ancient One, the seat of the throne of thy Lord, the Possessor of nations. Verily thy Lord doeth what He willeth, and He is the Mighty, the Bestower. We have desired to answer him whose letter hath come before the Wronged One, that the verses may draw him to the Dayspring of knowledge.

## BH10986: God the true One is My Witness! This… {.unnumbered}

God the true One is My Witness! This is the Day whereon it is incumbent upon everyone that seeth to behold, and every ear that hearkeneth to hear, and every heart that understandeth to perceive, and every tongue that speaketh to proclaim unto all who are in heaven and on earth, this holy, this exalted, and all-highest Name.

## BH11683: O Aba'l-Ma'ali! Upon thee be the peace of God… {.unnumbered}

O Aba'l-Ma'ali! Upon thee be the peace of God and His glory. By My life! Never have the breezes of thy remembrance ceased to waft over the court of the Wronged One. We, truly, love thee, and We exhort thee unto that whereby the station of the loved ones of God may be exalted amidst His servants. We beseech Him to protect thee and to ordain for thee the good of this world and of the world to come. Verily, He is the Lord of mankind, and the Lord of the Throne on high and of earth below.

## BH11858: Praise be to God, Who hath manifested the essences… {.unnumbered}

Praise be to God, Who hath manifested the essences of primal realities, and caused them to descend into the realms of lordship. Upon them there hath sprinked the attractions of the worlds of Divinity, whereat all have been thunderstruck, wholly and utterly, by these wondrous countenances newly revealed. And He, in His own Self, hath ever been the Truth, sanctified above all beginnings and endings, exalted beyond the accidents and substances of contingent being, inasmuch as He is the Beloved within the cloud-realm of Divinity and the Beauty of the kingdom of Godhead. And verily, by My Beauty, He hath in Our sight ever been praised and [all-merciful].

## BH11859: A hundred thousand praises be upon those who, at… {.unnumbered}

He is.

A hundred thousand praises be upon those who, at one stroke, shattered the idols and found repose beneath the shadow of the All-Knowing King. By My Beauty! At this moment, through the light of Baha, through a radiant sun, thou art known amongst the denizens of the Concourse on high. God willing, mayest thou ever remain confirmed by divine assistance. Fear not, and speak, for at whatsoever time thou speakest for the sake of God, the Holy Spirit shall assuredly confirm thee. And for him in particular, several Tablets have been sent, both aforetime and thereafter.

## BH11120: By the life of God! There hath been ordained… {.unnumbered}

...By the life of God! There hath been ordained for the loved ones that which the pens of the world are powerless and incapable of describing. Some servants were observed who came on account of a word and departed on account of another word. The colors of two days prevented and deprived them of eternal favors and everlasting bounties....

## BH11098: God is Most Glorious! {.unnumbered}

God is Most Glorious!

My Most Exalted Pen hath testified to thy turning unto God, the Most High, the Most Exalted. This is a testimony that cannot be equaled by the treasures of the world nor by whatsoever the peoples possess. That which hath been ordained for thee by God, the Lord of the worlds, shall erelong be sent down. Rejoice thou in this bounty, then render thanks unto thy Lord, the All-Bountiful.

## BH11039: In the letter of the revered Afnan, his honor… {.unnumbered}

In the letter of the revered Afnan, his honor Aqa Mirza Muhammad-Taqi, upon him be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious—regarding what he had written that they had sent a letter to this servant which arrived, and that they had written and sent a detailed reply to it—God willing it has now arrived. And now they convey countless glorifications and praises.

## BH11037: O leaf! I hope that, by divine grace, you… {.unnumbered}

He is God.

O leaf! I hope that, by divine grace, you are safe and at rest. We sent Munirih—the choice is yours. We gave permission for fifteen days of service. O leaf! The Tree commands: do not fall short in knowledge, calligraphy and character. The human being requires the conditions of humanity. The Glory be upon you.

## BH11198: O Khanum, O Amatallah! That is, O My handmaid… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of the Lord!

O Khanum, O Amatallah! That is, O My handmaid, O thou the handmaid of God! It is hoped that in the path of His love thou art sanctified from all else save Him, fixing thy gaze upon the Holy Court in such wise that the tribulation encompassing thee in the path of God, the King, the Omnipotent Protector, the Self-Subsisting, will not cause thee sadness.

## BH11076: The Most Exalted Pen beareth witness unto him who… {.unnumbered}

He is the Wronged One.

The Most Exalted Pen beareth witness unto him who hath turned unto God, the Lord of all beings, and hath quaffed the choice wine of steadfastness from the hands of bounty and bestowal. He, verily, is the All-Witnessing, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. Glory be unto those who have attained unto the lights of the Countenance when the All-Merciful came with manifest sovereignty.

## BH11168: O ʿAbdu'l-Khaliq! Upon thee be My glory! The Kaaba… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Commanding, the All-Wise

O ʿAbdu'l-Khaliq! Upon thee be My glory! The Kaaba of God hath turned toward thee and commandeth thee to detach thyself from all else but Him, and to promote that rectitude which is the dawning-place of prosperity, that there may be ordained for thee from the Supreme Pen, in the Crimson Book, a bountiful, enduring, firm and everlasting reward that shall last as long as the Kingdom of God, the Lord of what was and what shall be, shall endure.

## BH11028: O ʿAbdu’llah! God willing, mayest thou abide beneath… {.unnumbered}

He is God

O ʿAbdu’llah! God willing, mayest thou abide beneath the shadow of God and be of them that remember Him. The living water floweth, mercy is manifest, and the sun is shining forth. From the true Friend—that is, from the Lord God—I beseech that He may cause thee to taste of the life-giving stream, grant thee a share of His mercy, and illumine thee with the lights of the sun. Convey unto the friends Our greetings.

## BH11019: O Aqa Mihdi! Wherefore hast thou been heedless… {.unnumbered}

He is God.

O Aqa Mihdi! Wherefore hast thou been heedless of the leaf of guidance? Thou hast been called by the name "Mihdi"; yet bind thy heart to the companions of guidance. Abide in the haven and the meadow of the Beloved—dwelling, as it were, in the precincts of fidelity—that thou mayest drink from the cup of purity, and quaff from the ocean of God, and behold thereafter with thine own eyes.

After this, act not contrary to thy former course, nor deviate, of set purpose, from that which thou didst aforetime pursue.

## BH11016: The beginning of all things hath been, and continueth… {.unnumbered}

He is the One dawning from the horizon of utterance.

The beginning of all things hath been, and continueth to be, faith in God, exalted be His glory; and the end thereof is steadfastness therein. Blessed is he who hath attained unto both the first and the last; verily, he is numbered among the people of inner meaning in the sight of God, the Lord of the worlds and the Desired One of them that have known Him.

## BH11003: O My Name the All-Forgiving! Through Thee have I… {.unnumbered}

O My Name the All-Forgiving! Through Thee have I been tried, and through Thee have I drunk what no one hath drunk, and tasted what no soul hath tasted. Were I not beholding Thee, I would have destroyed the wicked ones and delivered My chosen ones from the letters of fire. Had not My mercy preceded all things, I would have returned existence unto non-existence by reason of what hath befallen My loved ones—how much more by what hath befallen My Own Self!

## BH11021: O beloved! God willing, may you ever remain sheltered… {.unnumbered}

O beloved! God willing, may you ever remain sheltered beneath the protecting shade of the blessed divine Tree in perfect joy and fragrance, and in endless delight and felicity, occupied with the remembrance of the Friend, heedless of the grief and joy of the world and the pleasure and sorrow of humanity.

I have left to the people their religion and their world,

Being occupied with Thy remembrance, O Thou Who art my religion and my world!...

## BH11067: In Thy name, the All-Giving, the Most Effulgent! {.unnumbered}

In Thy name, the All-Giving, the Most Effulgent!

Glorified art Thou, O my God! I know not by what remembrance to remember Thee that would befit the majesty of Thy presence, for all remembrances beside Thine own fade away before the radiant splendor of the countenance of Thy remembrance. Therefore, through Thy generosity and grace, Thy loving-kindness and bounty, cause it to descend, O Thou in Whose hand are the keys of all remembrance! Verily, Thou hast power over all things.

## BH11041: The water of life is the divine utterance… {.unnumbered}

...The water of life is the divine utterance, and likewise His clear evidences. Strive that perchance the people of the world may attain eternal life through this everlasting stream and may illumine creation with the light of wisdom and utterance....

## BH11143: God is Most Pure {.unnumbered}

God is Most Pure.

O My Afnan! Upon thee be the peace of God and His glory. Turn thy face toward the Wronged One, detached from whatsoever hath been and whatsoever shall be, and place thy trust in God, the All-Subduing, the Self-Subsisting.

O My leaves! Upon you be the peace of God, the Lord of the Names. Turn ye toward the Most Exalted Horizon. Thus hath the decree been ordained: the command is God's—the Originator of the heavens and the Creator of all things.

## BH11164: O Khalíl! Blessed art thou, for thou hast visited… {.unnumbered}

O Khalíl! Blessed art thou, for thou hast visited the two Houses: one built by the Friend, and the other raised by the All-Glorious. The first He entered not, and from the second He departed not. We have remembered thee and were with thee in all conditions. Give thanks unto thy Lord for this mighty bounty. Praise be to God, the Lord of all the worlds.

## BH11035: O Mihdi! Drink thou the everlasting nectar flowing… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of the Beloved of the world!

O Mihdi! Drink thou the everlasting nectar flowing from the Divine Word through the Hand of bounty, and partake of the most pure Kawthar streaming from the direction of the Most Great Scene through the Hand of grace. Say: Praise be unto Thee, O Thou Who hast honored me with the trace of Thy Pen and hast called me with the tongue of the Manifestation of Thine Essence while He was imprisoned among the oppressors.

## BH11124: O My Majd: His Honour Badi' attained the presence… {.unnumbered}

He is the Almighty

O My Majd: His Honour Badi' attained the presence and stood before it, and desired to manifest a token of favour unto you. From the Wronged One he sought permission; therefore these two words were penned and sent, that he might obtain that which he desired, and that you might be blessed with this most great bounty. Praise be to God, the Lord of the worlds.

## BH11169: O Abdullah! We have turned towards thee from this… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Exalted, the Most High

O Abdullah! We have turned towards thee from this exalted Station and make mention of thee with a remembrance wherewith nothing can compare, and I am the All-Seeing, the All-Informed. It behooveth thee to preserve thy station through the Name of thy Lord and to remember Him at all times. Soon thou shalt behold the Sun of My Cause from the Most Exalted Horizon. Thus doth the All-Knowing inform thee. The glory be upon thee.

## BH11118: By the life of God! Such wrong was committed… {.unnumbered}

...By the life of God! Such wrong was committed against the Seal of the Prophets by the Shi'ih party that none save God can reckon it. Some wrongful, heedless souls, moved by self and desire, forsook the root and clung to the branch. Concerning these matters some poets have mentioned that which caused the very essence of truth to weep....

## BH10988: Your flowing verses caused joy and delight to hearts… {.unnumbered}

Your flowing verses caused joy and delight to hearts, and were specifically presented at the Most Holy Court. Praise be to God that you have attained this greatest gift. Blessed are you for having drunk from the Living Waters and attained the praise of our Lord, the Most Merciful. God willing, may you ever be speaking His praise and engaged in His remembrance.

## BH11197: The tongue of Divine Unity magnifies upon thy face… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Wise

The tongue of Divine Unity magnifies upon thy face, O Samadiyyih. We beseech God to assist thee in detachment in both beginning and end, and to solace thine eyes through the favors of thy Lord, the Possessor of all existence. Return thou to the abode of security and the seat of fellowship, near unto the mighty King. The glory be upon thee and upon those with thee.

## BH11047: O Husayn! This is a Tablet which remembereth thee… {.unnumbered}

He is the Beloved

O Husayn! This is a Tablet which remembereth thee from before the Wronged One, and by which the Concourse on High remembereth thee through the everlasting Book of God, the Lord of all beings. Say: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Praise be unto Thee for having enabled me to attain unto Thy presence and to hear Thy voice, as I stand before the door of Thy bounty. I beseech Thee to open before my face the door of Thy blessings and loving-kindness. Verily, Thou art the All-Bountiful, the All-Generous.

## BH11861: There is but one reality and one essence… {.unnumbered}

...There is but one reality and one essence that is expounded in the worlds of outer form and, at each of its stages, is described by a specific name... in accordance with the degrees of its particular manifestations on the plane of this limited world.

## BH10995: O my God! ‘Ali, Thy servant, seeketh reunion… {.unnumbered}

He is God

O my God! ‘Ali, Thy servant, seeketh reunion with Thee. Thou knowest and art aware that he is renowned for Thy love, and that in Thy path he hath beheld what the people of truth have beheld, both in former times and in these latter days. Ordain for him, then, from the Pen of Thy grace, that which shall draw him nigh unto Thee in every world of Thy worlds. Verily, Thou art the Forgiving, the Merciful.

## BH11008: O My servant! Verily thy Lord, when He chastiseth… {.unnumbered}

O My servant! Verily thy Lord, when He chastiseth His servants, is called by His name the Just One, and when He forgiveth, is called by His name the All-Forgiving, and He careth not whether He be called by this or by that, for verily He is sanctified above all names, and verily He is the One possessed of such power as none knoweth save His own Self, the All-Knowing.

## BH11026: In My Name, the All-Glorious {.unnumbered}

In My Name, the All-Glorious.

O Lord! Since Thou hast opened unto the faces of Thy creatures the gate of Thy presence, close it not, in Thy bounty. And since Thou hast called them unto the ocean of union with Thee, withhold them not, in Thy grace.

O Lord! Make known unto them Thy way, and the path which Thou hast manifested in Thy days. Verily, Thou art the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. Praise be to God, the Lord of all the worlds.

## BH11042: Blessed be ye, O women of the pavilion… {.unnumbered}

He is God

Blessed be ye, O women of the pavilion of glory! May her honor hold fast to the cord of divine unity and rejoice in the grace of God.

Women and men occupy one and the same station before God. The most honoured of created beings before God have been, and are, the steadfast and upright souls. Glory be upon you, O women of the household, and peace be upon you.

## BH11052: Praise be to the Beloved of the worlds… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of the One Friend!

Praise be to the Beloved of the worlds, that thou hast attained unto the presence of the Dawning-Place of His Cause and the Manifestation of His grace, and hast been clothed with the robe of forgiveness from the hand of divine bounty. Beseech the True One, exalted be His glory, that thou mayest ever drink from the pure water of steadfastness and remain detached and free from all else but Him.

## BH11053: At this moment all who are in the heavens… {.unnumbered}

He is.

At this moment all who are in the heavens and on earth prostrated themselves before God, and the Holy Spirit breathed into the temples of the Concourse on High, and the Dove warbled in the midmost heart of eternity, and all necks bowed down before His command, while the proud were in the fire of hell and grievous peril, and verily He was witness over all things.

## BH11056: Convey greetings to the friends in that land. We… {.unnumbered}

Convey greetings to the friends in that land. We beseech God that He may assist all to do what is necessary and befitting. That honored one must at all times set the people ablaze with the remembrance of God, exalted be His glory, and His name. The Glory be upon you and upon those with you and upon those who have said "We believe in God, the Single, the All-Informed."

## BH11062: Glorified be He Who hath adorned thy temple… {.unnumbered}

He is the Dawning One from the horizon of eternity!

Glorified be He Who hath adorned thy temple with the ornament of hearing and brought thee into the presence of the Throne and caused thee to hear His wondrous and glorious call. Nothing can be compared with this, nay, by the Lord of the worlds! Be thou thankful in all circumstances, then praise Him and say: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having strengthened me and honored me and brought me into Thy noble presence.

## BH11063: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech… {.unnumbered}

He is the Preserver

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name, and Thy Most Mighty Word, and by Thy Most Beautiful Names and Thy Most Exalted Attributes, that Thou protect this servant from every affliction and decree, and from every epidemic and plague, and from whatsoever tribulations and hardships may arise in the earth. Verily, Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest, and Thou art the Mighty, the Self-Subsisting.

## BH11071: Glorified art Thou, O my God, O Creator… {.unnumbered}

He is the Ever-Abiding

Glorified art Thou, O my God, O Creator of names and Fashioner of earth and heaven! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Holy, Most Glorious Beauty to make the hearts of Thy servants sanctified from self and desire, that Thy love may be established therein, O Thou Who hast raised up the heaven. Verily Thou art God; there is none other God but Thee, the One Who dominates all things and Who has power over all things, by Thy Most Glorious Name.

## BH11077: God beareth witness that there is none other God… {.unnumbered}

He is the Reckoner, the All-Knowing.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. His are glory and majesty and bounty. He guideth whomsoever He willeth unto the Euphrates of His mercy which hath preceded all who are in the heavens and on the earth.

O My name! Upon thee be My glory. Should anyone ask thee concerning the lamp, say: It is amid tempestuous winds.

## BH11084: Blessed are ye, O exiles of the earth! Ye… {.unnumbered}

He is.

Blessed are ye, O exiles of the earth! Ye are they who have turned towards the realms of banishment out of longing to attain the presence of the Dayspring of the Light of Oneness, and have borne in the path of God that which caused the dwellers of the Kingdom to lament. Ye are they whom neither the might of princes held back from the Lord of Names, nor the croaking of the raven from your Lord, the Mighty, the All-Bestowing.

## BH11096: God hath heard thy call, and from the ocean… {.unnumbered}

God hath heard thy call, and from the ocean of His bounty hath He revealed unto thee the pearls of His loving care. Give thanks unto Him at all times, and glorify His praise in spirit and with a heart perfumed with the sweet savour of His remembrance.

The Cause is in His hand; verily, He is the All-Powerful, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful. We exhort the servants to that which draweth them nigh unto God, and the handmaidens to that which is meet and befitting for them in these days.

## BH11101: To be typed {.unnumbered}

To be typed.

## BH11119: By the life of God! The sea hath been… {.unnumbered}

By the life of God! The sea hath been withheld from its billows, the sun from its shining, and the Lote-Tree from its fruits. The people have denied that which hath appeared and come to pass, and have turned away from God, the Lord of all mankind.

In the name of truth, one may be seated in the loftiest station and reclining upon the highest cushions—yet, for all that, be turned away from Him.

> "Verily, they that fear God among His servants are the learned."

## BH11121: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of our Most Holy, Most Great, Most Exalted, Most Glorious Lord!

Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having enabled Thy servants and handmaidens to make mention of Thee and to offer Thy praise, and to serve Thy Cause. I beseech Thee to assist them under all conditions to do that which Thou lovest and art pleased with. Verily, Thou art the One Who hath power over whatsoever He willeth, and the One Who holdeth dominion over all things. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Forgiving, the All-Merciful.

## BH11123: He has ever brought into being whatsoever He willeth… {.unnumbered}

He has ever brought into being whatsoever He willeth as He willeth and created whatsoever He desireth as He desireth. There was no cause for Thy creation save Thy bringing it into being, and no reason for Thy invention save Thy origination of it. All manifestations with Thee are but a motionless creation which Thou didst bring forth from nothing and to which Thou didst say "Be."

## BH11126: We bear witness that there is none other God… {.unnumbered}

He is the Almighty

We bear witness that there is none other God but Him, in acknowledgment of His oneness and in confession of His singleness. We have named the child after the Seal of the Prophets—may the spirit of all who dwell in the Kingdom of Names be a sacrifice unto Him—and We beseech God to bless you and to send down upon you from the heaven of grace a blessing and a favor from His presence. Verily, He is powerful over all things.

## BH11128: The mystic knower is he who knoweth the Manifestation… {.unnumbered}

The mystic knower is he who knoweth the Manifestation of My Self in My Beauty which dawneth forth through My Name in the vesture of Mine Order that is sanctified from all except Me, and who speaketh forth My remembrance and [praise], and who gazeth with Mine eye upon My sovereignty and power and then upon My Manifestations and creation. Thus hath it been ordained by My Pen for My creatures and My servants.

## BH11140: O Ismi! It was ordained that a small sum… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted is He in might and power

O Ismi! It was ordained that a small sum be conveyed by Jinab-i-Aqa Siyyid Ali in Beirut to Jinab-i-Aqa Ali—upon him be the peace of God. Yet, since he was not worthy, We were not pleased that it should be given thus; therefore We Ourselves are giving it. Accordingly, let your honour inspect the letter of Aqa Siyyid ʿAli and deliver it. And since We are giving it, he should assuredly have known, and know, and they too must needs accept it. Keep this matter concealed; let no one be informed of it.

## BH11145: O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name… {.unnumbered}

O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name which Thou hast made the sovereign over all names to ordain for me that which shall profit me in this world and the next, and to establish me in Thy service amidst all created things. There is no God but Thee, the Giving, the Bountiful, the Mighty, the Merciful. Moreover, forgive me for what I have wrought in Thy days, and by Thy grace and generosity blot out my misdeeds. Verily, Thou art powerful and mighty over this.

## BH11150: God is Most Glorious {.unnumbered}

God is Most Glorious

O people of Baha! We counsel you with that which We counseled Our messengers before, and We command you to patience and resignation in what hath befallen you in the path of God, the Lord of all worlds. Remind the people in the days of thy Lord and give them glad tidings of that which hath been ordained for them in the Psalms and Tablets and in My perspicuous Book.

## BH11200: I swear by God! So great are the things… {.unnumbered}

I swear by God! So great are the things ordained for the steadfast that were they, so much as the eye of a needle, to be disclosed, all who are in heaven and on earth would be dumbfounded, except such as God, the Lord of all worlds, hath willed to exempt.

## BH11204: Were mankind to give heed in a befitting manner… {.unnumbered}

Were mankind to give heed in a befitting manner to no more than one word of such a praise it would be so filled with delight as to be overpowered and lost in wonder. Entranced, it would then shine forth resplendent above the horizon of true understanding.

## BH11860: O My handmaiden! Hearken unto the call of thy… {.unnumbered}

O My handmaiden! Hearken unto the call of thy Lord from the direction of the Throne, then give thanks and prostrate thyself before Me, then remember and be devoutly obedient and be thou among the thankful women. Then be patient and show forth patience and depart not from the precincts of thy Lord, that thou mayest be numbered among the contented ones. And the Spirit be upon thee and upon those women who have believed in God and were among those who attained.

## BH11296: This is My letter unto her who hath heard… {.unnumbered}

He is the Eternal!

This is My letter unto her who hath heard My voice and drawn nigh unto Me. Verily, she is a leaf that hath sprung from this preexistent Root. She hath revealed herself in My name and tasted of the sweet savours of My holy, My wondrous pleasure. At one time We gave her to drink from My honeyed Mouth, at another caused her to partake of My mighty, My luminous Kawthar. Upon her rest the glory of My name and the fragrance of My shining robe.

## BH11251: Convey greetings to all the loved ones and forbid… {.unnumbered}

Convey greetings to all the loved ones and forbid them from idle pastimes and games. The wine of love for the Peerless Lord and the cup of knowledge of the eternal Sovereign suffices for all who dwell in the realm. And greetings be upon those who follow the Truth.

## BH11318: O Ahmad! Praise be to God Who created thee… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Merciful, the Compassionate

O Ahmad! Praise be to God Who created thee and sustained thee and taught thee and caused thee to know and guided thee to His straight path. Peace be upon thee and upon [thy father] and thy uncle and upon those who are with you for the sake of God.

## BH11240: His exalted Word {.unnumbered}

His exalted Word:

We have ordained for him that which We have ordained for no other, and verily he dwelleth in the Most Glorious Horizon and the Most Exalted Station. Blessed is he who hath attained unto this Most Supreme and Most Resplendent Station. We had promised him aforetime that We would bring to pass that which he loveth and desireth. Verily He is the Intended One, the Lord of the Throne on high and of the earth below.

## BH11305: The Point of Servitude remembers you. And I have… {.unnumbered}

He is He.

The Point of Servitude remembers you. And I have written another letter enclosed to Siyyid Ibrahim—if you deem it advisable, deliver it, otherwise do not. Two writings from the blessed pen were sent to you—one a prayer and the other a letter.

## BH11332: O Sulayman! Hear thou with the ear of thine… {.unnumbered}

O Sulayman! Hear thou with the ear of thine innate nature the voice of the Wronged One, and hold fast unto the Strong Cord of God. The world is transient, and that which is with God endureth. Strive thou that perchance thou mayest attain unto such knowledge as its fragrance shall never cease, and whose mention shall not be erased from the scroll of them that have turned unto God. Verily, He is the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.

## BH11312: He hath done well to desire thus. We have… {.unnumbered}

He hath done well to desire thus. We have permitted him to turn towards the All-Highest Horizon with joy and radiance, but in all circumstances they must observe wisdom in such manner that it does not cause any disturbance. Verily, He is the Announcer, the Informer, the Answerer, the All-Willing.

## BH11319: God is Most Glorious! {.unnumbered}

God is Most Glorious!

O Asad! Upon thee be My glory and My mercy. The tongue of My grandeur hath borne witness in thy favour, and in praise of thy remembrance, thy laudation, thy turning unto Him, thy teaching, and thy arising to champion the Cause of God, thy Lord, the Most High, the Most Exalted.

## BH11330: O daughter of Muhammad-Taqi! Praise be to God… {.unnumbered}

He is God!

O daughter of Muhammad-Taqi! Praise be to God that your father turned towards the Most Exalted Horizon and attained unto service, attainment of His presence, listening and witnessing. That which no eye hath seen nor ear heard hath been ordained for him. Verily thy Lord is the Helper, the All-Bountiful.

## BH11274: Blessed art thou for having recognized My Self… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Forgiving

Blessed art thou for having recognized My Self and turned away from all else beside Me among Mine enemies, and for having been touched by tribulations in My path and by rest in My love. Rest hath not been ordained save beneath the shadow of My loving-kindness and near the sanctuary of My mercy. Seize thy chance thereof and be thou of the thankful ones.

## BH11238: O My Majd! God willing, mayest thou abide beneath… {.unnumbered}

He is.

O My Majd! God willing, mayest thou abide beneath the shelter of the Divine Presence and the sovereign might of the All-Merciful, safeguarded and preserved; and from the evils of the exponents of self and the dawning-places of satanic promptings mayest thou find rest and peace within the sanctuary of the Lord’s protection. All this is of the bounty of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Powerful.

## BH11297: Majdu'd-Din: Upon thee be My glory. Send word… {.unnumbered}

He is the Self-Sufficing, the Most Exalted.

Majdu'd-Din: Upon thee be My glory. Send word to the Mansion, to the service of the Greater Branch, that there will be no departure tomorrow, for the matter of the post remaineth delayed. Therefore, after it hath been sent, the departure will take place. Accordingly, on Wednesday, at sunset, God willing, We shall set forth. Glory be upon thee.

## BH11335: O Sword of God! Necks have grown long… {.unnumbered}

He is the Manifest One

O Sword of God! Necks have grown long with hypocrisy, but God has forbidden the rule of the sword and ordained in its place loving-kindness and glory. Blessed is he who casts away what he has and takes up what is commanded by God, the Lord of all men.

## BH11207: For every matter there is a means… {.unnumbered}

He is the Ordainer, the All-Wise.

For every matter there is a means and a path, and for every ailment an antidote. The antidote to poverty, in one respect, is endeavor in one's occupation. Seek ye wealth through work and livelihood. Wealth is born of this endeavour and is the fruit of the tree of trustworthiness.

## BH11208: For every malady a remedy hath been ordained… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Wise

For every malady a remedy hath been ordained, and for every poison an antidote appointed. The antidote to poverty is endeavor and occupation. Seek ye wealth through labour and earning. Wealth is born of this endeavour and is the fruit of the tree of trustworthiness.

## BH11212: Praise be to God! The sun of bounty… {.unnumbered}

Praise be to God! The sun of bounty is shining forth, and the ocean of generosity is presentâ€"the former at all times in its radiance, and the latter at every moment in its surging waves. From God do We beseech that He may grant unto all their portion, that they may circle round about Himâ€"most especially that honoured and noble lady. Verily, He is potent over all things.

## BH11218: O Hasan! Be still, for the preservation… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Holy, the Most Exalted

O Hasan! Be still, for the preservation of that motion which God has sanctified from all motions, and from the three natural motions which are [the six]. Thus does the Lord of creation make mention of thee that thou mayest glory in His remembrance amongst His servants.

Verily, the essence [jawhar] is but a single word. It hath shone forth from the mouth of the Divine Will, and through it appeared that heat which God hath made the cause of motion in the world. Through it all things are sustained, though they be veiled therefrom. Thus have We detailed the matter in the Book. All things have been realized through the Word of thy Lord. By My life, this is indeed the decisive utterance!

Blessed art thou for having forsaken idle fancy and turned unto guidance in the days of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower. Hold fast unto the cord of His Cause and cleave unto this hem which God hath sanctified from all other hems. Verily, the glory be upon thee and upon My loved ones unto whom the glance of My loving-kindness hath been directed in all conditions.

## BH11220: Verily, the Divine Lote-Tree maketh mention of its Afnan… {.unnumbered}

Verily, the Divine Lote-Tree maketh mention of its Afnan, gladdening them with its favor and loving-kindness, and beareth witness unto them even as His Most Exalted Pen hath borne witness to their nearness, their turning unto Him, their orientation, and their acknowledgment. Blessed is he who hath attained unto this Most Great Remembrance from the Lord of everlasting dominion.

## BH11221: O thou who art named Rahim! Look not upon… {.unnumbered}

O thou who art named Rahim! Look not upon any in the Bayan save through the mystery of God and His veil, for We, verily, have ever been of those who conceal. That is, he was admonished not to censure or fault the people of the Bayan for their deeds, even as they themselves were wont to cover over and to shut their eyes to such things.

## BH11225: O concourse of divines! Adorn the head of knowledge… {.unnumbered}

O concourse of divines! Adorn the head of knowledge with the crown of deeds, then with sincerity and the fear of God, and adorn its neck with the pearls of fairness, then clothe its temple with the brocade of love and the silk of justice, if you hear the call of God and act according to what you are commanded.

## BH11229: Man is like unto a sword, and its essence… {.unnumbered}

Man is like unto a sword, and its essence is forbearance and piety. As long as it remains sheathed in the scabbard of self, its quality remaineth unknown. Supplicate ye the All-Glorious that all may attain unto the station of maturity, which is the station of certitude and recognition.

## BH11230: God willing, mayest thou be gladdened by this divine… {.unnumbered}

He is the Friend

God willing, mayest thou be gladdened by this divine springtime and by the morning breeze, and amidst the trees of existence mayest thou give utterance to the words, ʿVerily, He is the Best-Beloved.' Save the Friend, all are perishable and lost; He alone abideth, everlasting and present. Drink thou from the living waters of His praise, and quaff, at every moment, from the choice wine of His love. Glory be upon thee.

## BH11231: God willing, mayest thou be set aflame… {.unnumbered}

He is God

God willing, mayest thou be set aflame by the fire of the Beloved’s face, and by His light illumine the horizons. Thy mother conveyeth her greetings, and saith:

> "I have made, and continue to make, mention of you and of Jinab-i-Nazir in the presence of the True One."

## BH11234: O God! From the surging waves of the seas… {.unnumbered}

O God! From the surging waves of the seas I heard Thy praise; upon the mountain-heights did I behold Thee. By the riverbanks I called Thee to remembrance, and beside the running brooks I communed with Thee time and again. In every place did I remember Thee.

## BH11235: O Friend! By the locks of Thy musk-scented hair… {.unnumbered}

O Friend! By the locks of Thy musk-scented hair, which hath cut off the destitute dwellers of the valley of search from all hope and expectation through the majesty of a new affliction, and hath, through the might of severe trials, debarred the captives in the realm of desire from the everlasting sign of the ultimate goal.

## BH11239: This passage—that is, the interpretation of the sun… {.unnumbered}

This passage—that is, the interpretation of the sun and the moon—was written in accordance with the beliefs of the Shi'ih party, inasmuch as the purpose of composing this book was the guidance of that people. We bear witness that they are of them that forge falsehoods, save such as come unto God with a stainless heart.

## BH11241: We arrived at the house of Jinab-i-Diya—upon him be… {.unnumbered}

He is the Almighty

We arrived at the house of Jinab-i-Diya—upon him be the most glorious of all glory and the brightest of all light’s radiance—and a company was present in that house. All were blessed with meeting and presence. Blessed be they, both men and women. One point of yearning remaineth: it is for thee. Glory be upon all.

## BH11242: And likewise He saith {.unnumbered}

And likewise He saith:

In the name of God, write: In all matters let them have due regard for the dignity of the Cause. Whatever may be inhaled of the odor of violation in the Cause, from that must they needs refrain. Thus doth the Wronged One admonish thee in truth, and He, verily, is the Ordainer, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

## BH11244: We entered the garden, yet all its buds had… {.unnumbered}

He is the Almighty

We entered the garden, yet all its buds had vanished; We passed on into a thorny waste. Flowers of every hue and kind were strewn in heaps. It was as though the Resurrection itself had come to pass, and all affairs were seen to be reversed: the lowly exalted, and the flame itself grown dim. By the life of God! A veritable enchantment is here made manifest; unto God must one flee for refuge.

## BH11245: In the name of God, upon thee be His… {.unnumbered}

He is God

In the name of God, upon thee be His grace, O Badi'! God willing, in peace and safety shalt thou enter the rose-garden of the mercy of the All-Merciful, which is the resort of sweet fruits and heavenly produce. The pomegranate is expectant, and the apple likewise full of hope, waiting to see what thy fortune shall accomplish.

## BH11246: After two hours of the day had passed, We… {.unnumbered}

In the name of God, the Almighty

After two hours of the day had passed, We arrived. You are there, and We are here, with the fire of separation ablaze; from God have We sought, and do seek, reunion and meeting. Either may He draw you hither, or send Us unto you. Convey to all the friends Our greeting of Allah-u-Abha. And peace be upon you.

## BH11248: In the words of the poet, "The desert… {.unnumbered}

He is God

In the words of the poet, "The desert and the garden are alive, for this is the quarter of the Beloved"; wherefore, the sooner ye return unto the Most Transcendent Scene, the better. God willing, may ye ever, and unto everlasting, abide present and watchful in the presence of the All-Merciful. The glory be upon you.

## BH11249: Rejoice not in the world and whatsoever it contains… {.unnumbered}

Rejoice not in the world and whatsoever it contains. By God's life! Every treasure hath been and is the cause of infinite grief and sorrow and regret. Never hath any perishable thing been the cause of independence, nor shall it ever be.

## BH11252: All created things bear witness that this is His… {.unnumbered}

All created things bear witness that this is His Day and this is His season. With but one word hath He subdued the world and its peoples. Exalted be His bounty; exalted be His grace, which hath encompassed the world, and His munificence, which hath embraced all existence, from the first ones unto the last.

## BH11257: Mention was made of Hadrat-i-Muballigh and Jinab-i-Afnan, upon them… {.unnumbered}

He is God

Mention was made of Hadrat-i-Muballigh and Jinab-i-Afnan, upon them be the Glory of God and His mercy, in the Most Holy and Most Exalted Presence. He said: Verily He hath ordained for them that which befitteth His grace. Verily He is the Generous, the Kind.

## BH11258: The mention of Ghulam-Rida Khan hath been made. Blessed… {.unnumbered}

The mention of Ghulam-Rida Khan hath been made. Blessed is he, for he hath laboured in the path of God according to that which the Concourse on high hath uttered.

O Ghulam-Rida! Upon thee be the glory of all things, and the glory of all who are on earth and in heaven, and the glory of all who dwell in the kingdom of the Cause and of creation.

## BH11263: Glorified art Thou, O Thou by Whose Name… {.unnumbered}

Glorified art Thou, O Thou by Whose Name the lands have been illumined and the peoples subdued! I beseech Thee by Thy Name, the Manifest and the Hidden, through which the Trumpet was sounded and He Who spoke with Moses upon Sinai found utterance, to ordain for him who hath quaffed the choice wine of meeting Thee the good of the world to come and of this present world. Verily, Thou art the Lord of all mankind; there is none other God but Thee, the Strong, the Omnipotent.

## BH11264: The ear of the just sovereign standeth attentive… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be He.

The ear of the just sovereign standeth attentive, that it may hear the cry of the wronged; and the eye awaiteth, that it may behold the account of the condition of the peoples of the world. We beseech God to sustain him through the agencies of heaven and earth. Verily, He is powerful over all things.

## BH11272: My glory is My Name, and My manifestation… {.unnumbered}

My glory is My Name, and My manifestation is My Beauty, and My fortress is My love, and My proof is My Self, and My power is My signs, and My creation is My verses, and My sovereignty is My might, and My abode is My prison, and My Tablet is My messenger, and My Pen is My Command, and My party is My trust, and My fingers are My companions, and the Promised One is attainment to My presence, the Mighty, the Wondrous.

## BH11273: O ye in mortal graves! The peace of God… {.unnumbered}

He is.

O ye in mortal graves! The peace of God, He Who is the Lord of Revelation and the Speaker on Sinai, rest upon you. Blessed are ye, for ye were endowed with faith in days when trembling seized the limbs of all religions. May the Glory of God rest upon you, upon the origin of your beings and the end thereof, and upon your outer temples and inner selves.

## BH11275: Give thanks unto God, thy Creator, for that He… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty, the Self-Subsisting.

Give thanks unto God, thy Creator, for that He hath accepted thy migration and hath numbered thee among those who were present before thee; and He hath raised thee from that station unto one wherein it is as though thou hadst attained His presence and wert of those who stand before Him.

The Spirit be upon thee, and upon the steadfast.

## BH11279: as a bounty from Us and a mercy… {.unnumbered}

...as a bounty from Us and a mercy from Our presence. We ask God to unite his family and provide the means by which his station may be elevated among the servants. Verily He is the Powerful, the Mighty, the Bestower.

## BH11280: Ahmad hath come—upon him be My peace… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of Him Who is mentioned in the Scriptures and in the Tablets.

Ahmad hath come—upon him be My peace and My glory—and hath desired to go forth bearing as gifts the utterance of revelation, the tokens of proof, the new bounty, and the wondrous table unto the Afnan of My Lote-Tree and unto My loved ones. [Thus] hath it been ordained: let him journey through the lands, and proclaim the verses of God, the Lord of all the worlds.

## BH11298: The matters were submitted. As for Jinab-i-Mirza Mustafa, he… {.unnumbered}

The matters were submitted. As for Jinab-i-Mirza Mustafa, he said that if there be some definite work, there is no objection. But concerning the money, the Blessed Beauty Himself said: ʿI have sent one hundred liras.' The essential thing is that there should be some undertaking worthy of Mirza Mustafa's attention.

## BH11301: Mihdi and Ma‘sumih came and requested that a reply… {.unnumbered}

Mihdi and Ma‘sumih came and requested that a reply be written to your letter. With the utmost longing, joy, sincerity, and self-effacement do they express themselves in your service, and say:

> "In your stead, and as your representative, I am occupied in service."

Upon Khanum, my Khanum, and the others—upon them and upon them all be the glory of God, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

## BH11303: The letter of Samandar was received and perused. We… {.unnumbered}

The letter of Samandar was received and perused. We beseech God to protect him from the evil of every proud and tyrannical oppressor, and to aid him in service to the Cause, even as He aided him aforetime. Verily, from the earliest days until now, he hath been occupied in service; none would deny this save every wayward and sinful transgressor.

## BH11304: We beseech God to bless the steps… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of the Most Holy, the Most Great.

We beseech God to bless the steps of the newborn upon My Branch. Verily, He is the Hearer, the Answerer. And We have named the son Amínu'llah in this noble station.

Glory be upon him and upon his father, from the presence of One compassionate and generous; and upon his mother, and upon whoso serveth him. This is a great favour.

## BH11310: Every good thing is fair and pleasing. Blessed… {.unnumbered}

He is the Ever-Abiding!

Every good thing is fair and pleasing. Blessed is the hand that hath been privileged to write the verses of God, and the tongue that hath been moved to His remembrance. By the life of God! Being itself was created for this Day. The ocean of bounty is surging and the heaven of grace is uplifted. Joy to them that have attained!

## BH11313: There is no objection to what you have taken… {.unnumbered}

There is no objection to what you have taken as a means of livelihood, for the remembrance of the Wronged One is praiseworthy at all times and seasons. Make it a means for awakening those who slumber and rousing those who are heedless, through symbols and allusions and intimations, as the poet has said: "Listen thou to the tale thyself."

## BH11316: The time hath come for Mahd to transmute… {.unnumbered}

The time hath come for Mahd to transmute the poison of separation into the honey of reunion, and to allay the fires of remoteness with the Kawthar of the water of life and nearness; that is, to hasten unto the dwelling-place of the Beloved, and with heart and soul to turn unto the realm of the All-Merciful. Thus hath it been sent down from the presence of the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

## BH11320: O Ism-i-Jud! Upon thee be My glory and My… {.unnumbered}

O Ism-i-Jud! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness. The tea was apportioned; praise be to God, it was brought into the presence and was quaffed by the loved ones of God. Yet some still remained: send one box, or bring it thyself.

## BH11325: O handmaiden of God! We have come to visit… {.unnumbered}

He is

O handmaiden of God! We have come to visit thee and have approached thy resting place, and we beseech God to grant thee at all times what He hath ordained in the highest Paradise for the people of Baha. Verily, He doeth what He willeth by His command, and He is the Mighty, the All-Bestowing.

## BH11327: God is Most Glorious! {.unnumbered}

God is Most Glorious!

O thou who hast turned toward the Face of thy Lord! The deniers have desired to quench the light of the Lote-Tree and to extinguish its flame, and they have wrought that whereat the Supreme Paradise hath lamented.

Verily, from the presence of God, the Lord of the Mighty Throne, We exhort the people of Bahá to patience and steadfast endurance.

## BH11329: O thou who gazest upon the Countenance and art… {.unnumbered}

O thou who gazest upon the Countenance and art mentioned before the Throne! Thou hast turned unto God and set thy face toward the Countenance, and hast drunk the choice wine of reunion time after time, and the Kawthar of meeting again and again; and thou hast arisen to serve the Cause of thy Lord, the Most High, the All-Glorious.

The glory shining forth from the horizon of the heaven of My Kingdom be upon thee, and upon all who have laid fast hold upon the Most Firm Handle.

## BH11337: O thou assailant! By the life of God, thou… {.unnumbered}

O thou assailant! By the life of God, thou hast transgressed the bounds of justice, truth, and fairness. The sovereignty of ‘Umar was, for Islam, a manifest aid and a power made evident and resplendent. He arose with full resolve and attained the victory; but those beneath him have no portion of this station.

## BH11340: He said: O servant in attendance! For many days… {.unnumbered}

He said: O servant in attendance! For many days We walked, and His Honour Ismi—upon him be the Baha'i glory—would appear from afar, and a certain state and sign would be observed; but now, according to what the eye perceiveth [...]

## BH11349: O Mu'in! I bear witness that thou hast not… {.unnumbered}

O Mu'in! I bear witness that thou hast not been a helper [mu'in] unto any save thine own self and thy vain desire. God created thee that thou mightest be a helper unto Me and unto My Cause; yet thou didst arise to aid Mine enemies—those who pronounced judgement for the shedding of My blood.

## BH11352: O Himmat! Resolve and endeavour have ever been… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing

O Himmat! Resolve and endeavour have ever been, and continue to be, the key unto treasures that shall never perish. God willing, through the efforts of your honour, may those companions who are still wayfarers in the path of idolatry attain unto the fountainhead of true unity. This, verily, is not difficult for God.

## BH11353: O leaf! O handmaiden of God! Upon thee be… {.unnumbered}

He is.

O leaf! O handmaiden of God! Upon thee be the peace of God and His mercy and His light and His grace, and we beseech for thee the waves of the ocean of His forgiveness and the effulgent rays of the sun of His bounty. Verily, He is the Most Merciful of the merciful ones and the Most Generous of the generous ones.

## BH11359: Every single letter proceeding from Our mouth is endowed… {.unnumbered}

Every single letter proceeding from Our mouth is endowed with such regenerative power as to enable it to bring into existence a new creation—a creation the magnitude of which is inscrutable to all save God. He verily hath knowledge of all things.

## BH11361: O ye discerning ones! Verily, the words which have… {.unnumbered}

O ye discerning ones! Verily, the words which have descended from the heaven of the Will of God are the source of unity and harmony for the world. Close your eyes to racial differences, and welcome all with the light of oneness.

## BH11362: All the Divine Books and Scriptures have predicted… {.unnumbered}

All the Divine Books and Scriptures have predicted and announced unto men the advent of the Most Great Revelation. None can adequately recount the verses recorded in the Books of former ages which forecast this supreme Bounty, this most mighty Bestowal.

## BH11363: Blessed is he who loves the world simply… {.unnumbered}

Blessed is he who loves the world simply for the sake of the face of his generous Lord. With perfect compassion and mercy have we guided and directed The people of the world to that whereby their souls shall be profited.

## BH11364: Through the blood which they shed the earth hath… {.unnumbered}

Through the blood which they shed the earth hath been impregnated with the wondrous revelations of Thy might and the gem-like signs of Thy glorious sovereignty. Ere-long shall she tell out her tidings, when the set time is come.

## BH11365: In this day the tastes of men have changed… {.unnumbered}

In this day the tastes of men have changed, and their power of perception hath altered. The contrary winds of the world, and its colors, have provoked a cold, and deprived men's nostrils of the sweet savors of Revelation.

## BH11367: The divine who hath seized and quaffed the most… {.unnumbered}

The divine who hath seized and quaffed the most holy Wine, in the name of the sovereign Ordainer, is as an eye unto the world. Well is it with them who obey him, and call him to remembrance.

## BH11681: Whoso is imprisoned should not grieve; rather doth it… {.unnumbered}

Whoso is imprisoned should not grieve; rather doth it beseem him to rejoice, inasmuch as he hath followed his Lord in imprisonment...

## BH11379: In this day the banner of divine victory calls… {.unnumbered}

...In this day the banner of divine victory calls, and likewise the standard of transcendent glory, but the hosts beneath this standard are wisdom and utterance, and their commander is the fear of God....

## BH11377: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee… {.unnumbered}

...My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me to the Manifestation of Thy Self, the Dawning-Place of Thy Revelation and the Dayspring of Thy signs. O Lord! Ordain for me that which will render me detached from all else save Thee and cause me to hold fast to the hem of Thy luminous robe. Thou art, verily, the Mighty, the Great.

## BH11439: God is Most Glorious {.unnumbered}

God is Most Glorious

O Husayn, upon thee be My glory! The Wronged One maketh mention of thee and consoleth thee in what hath befallen thee. By God's life! We are with thee, and We are the One Who is near, the One Who watcheth. My glory be upon thee.

## BH11441: O servant of God! The Most Exalted Pen hath… {.unnumbered}

He is.

O servant of God! The Most Exalted Pen hath testified to thy acceptance and thy turning toward the Countenance. Upon thee be the glory of God and the glory of His loved ones and chosen ones, then of those who circle round the Throne at eventide and at dawn.

## BH11381: O My Name "The All-Forgiving" [al-Ghaffar]! Give thanks… {.unnumbered}

He is God!

O My Name "The All-Forgiving" [al-Ghaffar]! Give thanks to thy Lord, the All-Forgiving, for by His name "The All-Forgiving" He hath forgiven the sins of all the worlds, and verily He is the One Who chooseth, in the beginning and in the end.

## BH11382: O My Name! By My glory and grandeur… {.unnumbered}

O My Name! By My glory and grandeur and majesty: at the moment when I gaze upon thee, I see no one possessed of sin upon the face of the earth. Know this and conceal it.

## BH11432: This is what We promised thee aforetime: "Be patient… {.unnumbered}

This is what We promised thee aforetime:

> "Be patient until there passeth from the Bayan nine. Say: All was created in His grasp and all are obedient unto Him. Verily, after a time [ba'da hin] there shall come to you a Command which ye shall come to know."

## BH11394: This is a remembrance from the Tree of Love… {.unnumbered}

This is a remembrance from the Tree of Love which has descended upon the shore of the heart, and a fire from the treasury of nearness which is ignited in the Mount of the Tablet....

Mahjur Mirza Aqa

## BH11374: Give thanks unto God, for thy deed hath attained… {.unnumbered}

Give thanks unto God, for thy deed hath attained the honour of His acceptance. In lowliness supplicate Him, that thou mayest inhale the sweet fragrance of His good-pleasure. Verily, He is the All-Powerful, the Unconstrained.

We entreat Him, moreover, to make of thee a standard uplifted in the name of Him, the All-Subduing, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful.

## BH11380: Pay no attention to those who claim knowledge… {.unnumbered}

Pay no attention to those who claim knowledge for themselves, and let not the size of their turbans frighten you, nor their wagging tongues and their outcries when they deny the outpouring from this Dawning Cloud that is exalted, mighty and luminous.

## BH11385: O friend! The station of man is, in manifest… {.unnumbered}

He is the Speaker on the Mount

O friend! The station of man is, in manifest and evident utterance amidst the assemblage of the world, the sign of God and the sun of the universe.

## BH11386: O friend! From the shining forth of the star… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing

O friend! From the shining forth of the star of divine grace, reason was made manifest; and from reason justice was revealed and brought to light; and through these twain was the world adorned and established.

## BH11388: O friends! In this spiritual springtime, deprive not yourselves… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Hearing

O friends! In this spiritual springtime, deprive not yourselves of the outpourings of the All-Merciful. He it is Who is manifest, and He it is Who speaketh. He mentioneth thee as a bounty from His own presence, and He, verily, is the All-Bounteous, the Most Generous.

## BH11393: Beware lest ye forget courtesy, for a person… {.unnumbered}

Beware lest ye forget courtesy, for a person is known by his courteous behavior, not by his wealth. Take pride in your knowledge and refinement, not in your ancestors and garments. Hearken unto My counsel and be not of the heedless ones.

## BH11395: This Servant was not among the learned ones… {.unnumbered}

This Servant was not among the learned ones and had not traveled to distant lands, and according to outward appearance was born in the household of one of the government officials and was related to him.

## BH11398: These are the verses of the Book which have… {.unnumbered}

These are the verses of the Book which have been sent down in truth from the dominion of God, the Exalted, the Great...And I confirm what you possess of God's laws and ordinances, and I have come to you from Sinai with the call of God, the Exalted, the Triumphant, the Ancient.

## BH11401: Render thanks unto the Desire of the world, whose… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Glorious

Render thanks unto the Desire of the world, whose grace hath reached such a degree that He hath made mention of thee in the Most Great Prison. Know thou this, and be of them that are thankful.

## BH11407: God beareth witness that there is none other God… {.unnumbered}

God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him, and that I am He, and He is the Glory in this most exalted and magnificent ornament. O glad tidings unto you, O denizens of immortality!

## BH11408: God testifieth that there is none other God but… {.unnumbered}

He is.

God testifieth that there is none other God but Him. He giveth unto whomsoever He willeth whatsoever He desireth. He is, verily, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful. O My Afnan! Be not grieved at anything, for verily He is with you under all conditions. Husayn and ʿAli.

## BH11411: May a¹¢amadiyyih abide safe beneath the shadow… {.unnumbered}

He is God

May a¹¢amadiyyih abide safe beneath the shadow of the Lord of creation; mayest thou, in the fairest of melodies, give utterance to the remembrance of the All-Merciful, and with the utmost delight busy thyself in the praise of His attributes. And peace be upon thee.

## BH11413: The truly learned one is he whose knowledge prevents… {.unnumbered}

He is.

The truly learned one is he whose knowledge prevents him from all that My good-pleasure and His good-pleasure abhorreth, and the mature one is he who hath attained unto the dawning-place of My knowledge; and apart from this none is mature, even though he may live for [many] years.

## BH11414: Presented at the presence of Aqa Da'i Khan: God… {.unnumbered}

Presented at the presence of Aqa Da'i Khan: God willing, mayest thou ever quaff the Kawthar of divine love from the hand of the heavenly Cupbearer. Do thou drink there, and I, in this place, say unto thee, ʿMay it be pleasant and joyous unto thee.' All hope, verily, is set upon thee.

## BH11423: The Tongue of Revelation hath spoken: There is none… {.unnumbered}

He is.

The Tongue of Revelation hath spoken: There is none other God but Him, the One, the Chosen. Soon shall the banners of victory be upraised, and sovereignty shall remain with God, the Mighty, the All-Bestowing.

## BH11427: This is a Book that speaketh with truth, did… {.unnumbered}

He is the Self-Subsisting

This is a Book that speaketh with truth, did ye but know it. Verily it hath been sent down from God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting. It beareth glad-tidings of that which hath been ordained for mankind. Well is it with people who understand.

## BH11429: Mim, Ya, Lam. That which hath been revealed… {.unnumbered}

Mim, Ya, Lam. That which hath been revealed from the direction of the Throne unto him who hath been named Ibrahim, that he may be mindful of the remembrance of God, the All-Wise.

He is the Wondrous One in the Most Glorious Horizon.

Glorified be He Who hath sent down the verses unto a people who understand.

## BH11431: He hath been, and continueth to be, the succourer… {.unnumbered}

He hath been, and continueth to be, the succourer of the oppressed and the manifestation of the justice of God. By him are the eyes of the world illumined and made radiant. For his majesty and glory, his exaltation and loftiness, do We beseech of God, the Most High. Verily, He answereth them that supplicate Him.

## BH11436: O my God! Thy servant hath desired that Thou… {.unnumbered}

He is God.

O my God! Thy servant hath desired that Thou make him firm and steadfast in Thy Cause. Do Thou, through Thy might, confirm him therein; then ordain for him that which is befitting Thy bounty. Verily, Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.

## BH11437: O dwellers of the Most Exalted Paradise! Upon you… {.unnumbered}

He is.

O dwellers of the Most Exalted Paradise! Upon you rest the remembrance of God, and His praise, and His grace, and His favors, and His peace, and His blessings, and every goodly remembrance that hath been recorded in His Manifest Book.

## BH11440: O rustling of the Divine Lote Tree! Upon thee… {.unnumbered}

He is!

O rustling of the Divine Lote Tree! Upon thee be the glory of God, the Lord of all beings and Lord of the throne on high and of the dust below. And O fragrance from the Most Exalted Paradise! Upon thee be the peace of God, the Sovereign of all names and Creator of heaven.

## BH11444: O Lord of the Word and King of all… {.unnumbered}

O Lord of the Word and King of all created things!

I entreat Thee by the oneness wherewith Thou hast clothed Thy Temple as with a garment, and by the identity which Thou hast ordained the adornment of Thine own Self, that Thou mayest open for every atom a gate unto Thy meeting, and a path leading to the ocean of union with Thee.

## BH11445: O Muhammad Ja'far! May you be blessed, God willing… {.unnumbered}

O Muhammad Ja'far! May you be blessed, God willing, with divine grace! The True One, exalted be His glory, has counseled His servants in books, scriptures and psalms...

## BH11447: O thou who hast kindled the love… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Loving

O thou who hast kindled the love of the friends for Thy presence and whose remembrance is celebrated at all times in the gathering of them that are sincere! I render thanks unto God for having made thee turn toward Him and for having rendered thee acceptable in the sight of His believing servants.

## BH11449: O fragrances of the earth and its mysteries… {.unnumbered}

He is!

O fragrances of the earth and its mysteries, and leaves of the Divine Tree and its fruits! Blessed are ye, for ye have chosen for yourselves, beneath the shadow of your Lord's tender mercy, a station most exalted and a position most gracious.

## BH11453: The heavens of thy mercy and the oceans… {.unnumbered}

The heavens of thy mercy and the oceans of thy bounty are so vast that thou hast never disappointed those who begged of thee nor refused those who willed to come to thee!

## BH11455: He that partaketh of the waters of My Revelation… {.unnumbered}

He that partaketh of the waters of My Revelation will taste all the incorruptible delights ordained by God from the beginning that hath no beginning to the end that hath no end.

## BH11458: The face of the world hath altered. The way… {.unnumbered}

The face of the world hath altered. The way of God and the religion of God have ceased to be of any worth in the eyes of men.

## BH11459: All the saplings of the world have appeared… {.unnumbered}

All the saplings of the world have appeared from one Tree, and all the drops from one Ocean, and all beings owe their existence to one Being.

## BH11461: The Lote-Tree beyond Which there is no passing crieth… {.unnumbered}

The Lote-Tree beyond Which there is no passing crieth out, by reason of the cruelty of the divines. It shouteth aloud, and bewaileth itself....

## BH11488: in certain matters We look to means, and thus… {.unnumbered}

...in certain matters We look to means, and thus they remain in abeyance and are delayed. Otherwise, verily He causeth all things to flow with but a movement of His finger, and He is the Powerful, the All-Conquering, the Omnipotent....

## BH11513: O my God! Ordain for me through Thy Most… {.unnumbered}

O my God! Ordain for me through Thy Most Exalted Pen that which Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones.

## BH11478: O Forgiver! God willing, mayest thou be ever remembered… {.unnumbered}

O Forgiver! God willing, mayest thou be ever remembered before God and circle round His good-pleasure in all the worlds.

## BH11471: O My Name "The Just"! When We gaze upon… {.unnumbered}

O My Name "The Just"! When We gaze upon thee, We find none worthy to be gazed upon, for all are but fuel for the fire, which returneth them unto it.

## BH11529: God is Most Glorious {.unnumbered}

God is Most Glorious

O Afnan! Verily thy Lord, the Most Glorious, calleth thee to the supreme horizon and remembereth thee with that whose fragrance shall never cease to endure throughout the kingdom of earth and heaven.
